evidence_note.failure_signature: EncoderFailed: video encoder failed (0 frames accepted) - encoder-side failure, identical plan shape to the runs that passed
evidence_note.not_a_claim: This run does not certify the failing motions and does not replace a strict-lane sign-off; it records the current reproduction so the failures are explicit instead of historical.

control_runs.hardware_none_native: 20/20 render_failed in 5s (the strict lane requires the NVENC path)

root_cause_analysis.corrected_conclusion: The dominant failure is NOT the encoder and not motion semantics: the CLI reports EncoderFailed only because no frame ever reaches the encoder.
root_cause_analysis.cause_1_unsupported_shape: VulkanBackend::draw_node implements natively only grid, path fill, path stroke and solid rect (src/backends/vulkan/vulkan_native_shape_dispatch.cpp). Every other shape falls back to the legacy CPU backend, and the strict lane (--gpu-hot-path-mode require_gpu_native) deliberately attaches no fallback, so the node fails with UnsupportedCapability. Reproduced in isolation: image_corner_bloom fails alone with 'frame 0 failed ... UnsupportedCapability ... node=shape' while it emits four ellipse layers; the three motions that pass emit a single path layer.
root_cause_analysis.cause_2_device_loss: Independent Vulkan device loss during the CUDA/Vulkan export handoff: '[native_av] CUDA/Vulkan frame handoff failed: Vulkan device lost during vkWaitForFences(CUDA export slot)' followed by 'GPU worker is poisoned after a terminal device-loss failure'. Reproduced in isolation: image_card_flip_soft fails alone with three device-lost reports and no UnsupportedCapability.
root_cause_analysis.isolation_runs: Both defects reproduce in a fresh process with RENDERINGGEN_GPU_CERT_MOTION=<id>, so they are not a cascade of one poisoned run.
root_cause_analysis.owner: Chronon3d: (a) native support (or an accepted fallback policy) for the shape types the premium image motions emit, and (b) the CUDA/Vulkan handoff device loss. RenderingGen cannot certify these motions until either lands.
root_cause_analysis.not_a_claim: Neither defect is a RenderingGen semantic error, and this evidence does not certify any failing motion.
